name: Adamah's Redemption
description:
Combat Action: When your active character is Durin, equip this card.
After Durin equips this card, immediately use Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts or Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder once based on the character's current Elemental Burst.
When the character to which this is attached uses Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts: Your next 4 instances of DMG gain +1.
When the character to which this is attached uses Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder: Your Durin and Denial of Darkness deal +2 DMG.
(You must have Durin in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
